generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The Bidders shall quote the Concession Period in number of days in the Financial Bid as per Appendix-IB. The quoted Concession Period shall constitute the sole criterion for evaluation of Financial Bids. For the purposes of this Tender, the Concession Period shall commence from the Appointed date and shall include the construction period. The Concession Period quoted by a Bidder shall not exceed 11,863 (eleven thousand eight hundred and sixty three) days, being equivalent to 32.5 (thirty two point five) years from appointed date. Any Bid quoting a Concession Period exceeding 11,863 days shall be treated as non-responsive and shall be rejected. Further, notwithstanding any adjustment in Concession Period pursuant to the provisions of the Concession Agreement, including Article 29 (Effect of Variations in Traffic Growth), the total Concession Period shall in no event exceed 11,863 days from appointed date. The basis for fixation of the maximum Concession Period of 32.5 (thirty two point five) years is set out in Clause 1.2.11 of the RFP

The Authority has adopted a single stage two envelope process (referred to as the Bidding Process) for selection of the Bidder for award of the Project. Under this process, the Bid shall be invited under two envelopes. Prior to or along with the Bid, the Bidder shall pay to the Authority a sum of Rs.3,60,000 as the cost of the Bidding Process (calculated as Rs. 10,000 for every 100 Cr or part thereof) of Project Cost to be submitted in form of DD in Favor of Managing Director, BSMILE and Original DD shall be submitted along with EMD before tender opening. The copy of the DD shall be uploaded in KPPP along with other documents in technical bid. The bid without the bidding process fee shall be treated as Non- responsive) Eligibility and qualification of the Bidder (The Bidder, which expression shall, unless repugnant to the context, include the members of the Consortium) will be first examined based on the details submitted under first envelope (Technical Bid) with respect to eligibility and qualifications criteria prescribed in this RFP. The Financial bid under the second envelope (Financial Bid) shall be opened of only those Bidders whose Technical Bids are responsive to eligibility and qualifications requirements as per this RFP

Bids are invited for the Project on the basis of the Concession Period required by a Bidder for implementing the Project. The Authority shall provide fixed Viability Gap Funding of 40% of the Estimated Project Cost (i.e. 1,414.76 Cr being 40% of 3,536.89 Cr), and the Bidder shall quote the Concession Period required for recovery of its investment and returns from the Project in accordance with the terms of the Concession Agreement

The Concession Period quoted by a Bidder shall not exceed 11,863 (eleven thousand eight hundred and sixty three) days from appointed date. Any Bid quoting a Concession Period exceeding 11,863 days shall be treated as non-responsive and shall be rejected

The Concessionaire shall be entitled to levy and charge a pre-determined user fee from users of the Project. Toll / User Fee Framework: The levy, collection, rates and revision of user fee on the Project shall be governed by the Karnataka Road User Fee (Determination of Rates and Collection) Rules, 2014 (notification No. PWD 06 EAP 2012 (P3) dated 07-03-2015, issued under the Karnataka Highways Act, 1964), as amended from time to time, and the applicable Government of Karnataka toll notification for the Project. The base fee rates are as specified in the said Rules, and are subject to annual revision in accordance with Rule 5 thereof namely, an increase of 3% (three per cent) per annum (without compounding) together with 40% (forty per cent) of the movement in the Wholesale Price Index (WPI), as set out in the formula in the said Rules. The toll rates, indexation and the basis of revision adopted in the Feasibility Report and the financial model are consistent with this framework. No peak / off-peak or congestion pricing is permitted, and the user fee shall be revised only in accordance with the said Rules. The detailed fee provisions are set out in Article 27 of the Concession Agreement and the Fee Notification at Schedule-R thereof.
All other terms and conditions as per standard tender document

technicalCriterionList.description: 2.2.2 To be eligible for this RFP a bidder shall fulfil the following conditions of eligibility: AAA. For Stand-alone specialized projects: (a2) In case the cost of specialized project is more than Rs. 1,000 Cr: (Applicable for this project) The sole Bidder or in case the Bidder being a Joint Venture, any member of Joint Venture shall have completed at least one similar Major Bridge/RoB/Flyover project in the last 10 (Ten) financial years preceding the Bid Due Date, having span equal to or greater than 50% of the longest span of the structure proposed in this project or 100m, whichever is less, and also the cost of such similar project shall be at least 20% of the Estimated Project Cost or Rs. 1000 Cr., whichever is less. For this purpose, a project shall be considered to be completed, if more than 90% of the value of work has been completed and such completed value of work is equal to or more than 20% of the Estimated Project Cost or Rs. 1000 Cr., whichever is less

technicalCriterionList.description: To be eligible for this RFP a bidder shall fulfil the following conditions of eligibility: A. Technical Capacity: For demonstrating technical capacity and experience (the Technical Capacity), the Bidder shall, over the past 5 (five) financial years preceding the Bid Due Date, have: (i) paid for, or received payments for, construction of Eligible Project(s): and or (ii) paid for development of Eligible Project(s) in Category 1 and/or Category 2 specified in Clause 3.4.1: and or (iii) collected and appropriated revenues from Eligible Project(s) in Category 1 and or Category 2 specified in Clause 3.4.1, such that the sum total of the above, as further adjusted in accordance with clause 3.4.6. is more than Rs.5305.34 Crore (the Threshold Technical Capability) (being 1.5 times of the Estimated Project Cost) Provided that at least one fourth of the Threshold Technical Capability shall be from the Eligible Projects in Category 1 and or Category 3 specified in Clause 3.4 (a)

2.2.2. To be eligible for this RFP a bidder shall fulfil the following conditions of eligibility: (C) Specialized Agency / Sub-contractor: For the specialised UHPFRC / FRC and long-span structural works forming part of the Project, the Bidder may rely on the experience of a specialist subcontractor / agency proposed to be engaged for such works. The letter of association / MoU / Letter of Intent from the proposed UHPFRC / UHPC specialist agency may be submitted after the award of the Bid, and is not required to be submitted at the Bid stage. The credentials of the specialist subcontractor / agency shall be verified and approved by the Authority before the issue of the work order to such agency, in accordance with the Specifications and Standards and the relevant sub-contracting provisions of the Scope of Work

technicalCriterionList.description: 2.2.2 To be eligible for this RFP a bidder shall fulfil the following conditions of eligibility: (B) Financial Capacity: The Bidder shall have a minimum Net Worth (the Financial Capacity) of Rs.884.22 Crore (being 25% of the Estimated Project Cost) at the close of the preceding financial year. In case of a Consortium the combined technical capability and net worth of those Members who have and shall continue to have an equity share of at least 26% (twenty six per cent) each in the SPV, should satisfy the above conditions of eligibility: provided that each such Member shall, for a period of 2 (two) years from the date of commercial operation of the Project hold equity share capital not less than: (i) 26% (twenty six per cent) of the subscribed and paid up equity of the SPV: and (ii) 5% (five per cent) of the Total Project Cost specified in the Concession Agreement. Provided further that each member of the Consortium shall have a minimum Net Worth of 12.5% of Estimated Project Cost in the immediately preceding financial year.
All other relevant documents as per RFP
